guidance.bestFor: Plain text rows in 2 groups, the first headed My Account, with a disabled API row

whenNotToUse.when: One list that mixes flyouts, a theme radio set, a checkbox and a delete row

guidance.bestFor: One trigger per placement side, each opening the same 3 rows so the sides can be compared
agentNotes: `sides` exists only to show every placement; keep one value and pass it as `side` on `DropdownMenuContent`

guidance.bestFor: A leading icon on each row and a destructive Log out set apart below a separator
Key chord hints right aligned on every row of a short account list with no icons
agentNotes: `DropdownMenuShortcut` only prints the chord text; nothing listens for those keys, so bind them in your app

whenNotToUse.when: A searchable palette of actions opened from the keyboard and filtered by typing

guidance.bestFor: A single Invite users row between Team and New Team, opening a side flyout of Email, Message and a More row

whenNotToUse.when: A row of always visible top level headings such as File, Edit and View

guidance.bestFor: Layout toggles for 3 panels, each bound to its own boolean, with the Activity Bar one disabled
agentNotes: `showStatusBar`, `showActivityBar` and `showPanel` are local state; read and write them in your layout store

whenNotToUse.when: One choice that rules out the others, such as where a panel docks

guidance.bestFor: An exclusive pick of panel position among 3 arrow icon options, with Right disabled
agentNotes: `position` starts as bottom in local state; lift `value` and `onValueChange` to the code that places the panel

whenNotToUse.when: A choice inside a form that stays visible on the page without opening

guidance.bestFor: Every item kind together: an Open Recent flyout, a theme radio set in a flyout, a checkbox and a delete
agentNotes: `theme` and `notifications` live in local state only; connect Theme to your theme provider and the checkbox to settings

whenNotToUse.when: A short list of plain text rows with no icons, flyouts or toggles

guidance.bestFor: A named account button opening an avatar and email header over profile, team, help and log out rows
agentNotes: The name and photo are hardcoded in the trigger and again, with the email, in `DropdownMenuLabel`; pass in your signed in user

whenNotToUse.when: An account popover that also switches theme and presence status

guidance.bestFor: Switching among 3 workspaces shown by logo or avatar, name and plan, with a check on the active one and create or manage rows
agentNotes: Rows set `activeWorkspaceId` from `onSelect`, which Base UI never fires on a click; move that call to a click handler on the base twin
`workspaces` is sample data with brand logos; replace it with the user's own workspaces and their images

whenNotToUse.when: A switcher at the head of a full side navigation with grouped links

guidance.bestFor: A bell with a count badge, 3 avatar activity rows with times and unread dots, and a Mark all as read button
agentNotes: `notifications` is static sample data and the badge count is a fixed 8; derive both from your feed
Mark all as read is a plain `button` with no handler; wire it to clear the unread state

whenNotToUse.when: One line text alerts with no avatars, count badge or footer link

guidance.bestFor: Record actions on a vertical dots button: edit, duplicate, a move to flyout, share, copy link and delete
agentNotes: The trigger holds only an `aria-hidden` icon, so the button has no accessible name until you label it

whenNotToUse.when: A short list of 3 actions on a borderless horizontal dots button

guidance.bestFor: A labelled Share button whose rows split into share channels and PDF, CSV or PNG export, ending in Print

whenNotToUse.when: A main action with a caret beside it that opens its alternatives

name: c-dropdown-menu-14
title: User profile dropdown menu with theme toggle and status selector
label: Theme & Status
description: User profile dropdown menu with theme toggle and status selector

guidance.bestFor: An account popover with an icon Tabs theme switch, count badges and a presence status flyout with colored dots
agentNotes: `theme` only drives the `Tabs` here; pass it to your theme provider so light, dark and system take effect
`onSelect` with `preventDefault` keeps the popup open on radix only; on the base twin set closeOnClick to false instead
Each theme `TabsTrigger` holds only an icon, so give it an accessible name such as Light, Dark or System

whenNotToUse.when: A plain account list with an email header and no theme or status controls

guidance.bestFor: A New button for customer, order and invoice records beside a bare avatar trigger for profile, billing and sign out
agentNotes: `user` holds a sample name, email and initials, and the photo URL sits inline in `AvatarImage`; pass your session user

whenNotToUse.when: One account button that shows the user's name and photo with a chevron

guidance.bestFor: A borderless horizontal dots button named More options, with Settings, Share and a destructive Remove

whenNotToUse.when: Record actions that need shortcuts, a move to flyout and copy link

guidance.bestFor: A ghost bell button opening 3 one line text alerts, the first with a trailing check mark
agentNotes: The check on the first row is a fixed `icons` entry with no state behind it; drive it from your own data

whenNotToUse.when: Alerts that need avatars, timestamps, unread dots and a count on the bell

name: c-dropdown-menu-18
title: AI model selector with provider icons
label: AI Model Selector
description: AI model selector with provider icons

guidance.bestFor: A Select model button listing 3 AI models by provider logo, with a dark variant for the logo that needs one
agentNotes: No row stores the pick and the trigger always reads Select model; keep the chosen `id` and show its `label` there
`menuItems` hardcodes 3 model names and brand logos; load the models your API serves

whenNotToUse.when: A form field whose button shows the chosen model and submits it
